title: Festive Fare: Caramel Apple Cobbler.
subtitle: Made to share – take a plate or dine in!
description: Make it an Australian festive season to remember with our collection of crowd-pleasing desserts. With tender apple and gooey caramel tucked underneath a gingerbread-spiced biscuit topping, this cobbler is out of this world!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 160C. Grease a 1.5L (6 cup) baking dish. Peel and core the apples, then cut into thick wedges. Finely chop 125g butter.

Cook caramel apple: Put 50g chopped butter, 75g (⅓ cup) brown sugar and 125ml (½ cup) cream in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until the sugar dissolves. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook for 5 mins or until slightly thickened. Add the apple and cook, stirring occasionally, for a further 8 mins or until tender. Remove the pan from the heat.

Start topping: Put 150g (1 cup) plain flour, 110g (½ cup) brown sugar, 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp ground ginger in a bowl. Add the remaining chopped butter and rub into the flour mixture with your fingertips until it resembles fine crumbs.

Bake cobbler: Add 60ml (¼ cup) milk to the flour mixture and stir until it comes together. Spoon the apple mixture into the prepared dish. Dot spoonfuls of the topping over the apple mixture. Bake for 45 mins or until the filling is bubbling and the topping is golden.
Serve up: Divide the cobbler among bowls and drizzle with the remaining cream (see Make it yours). Enjoy! Serves 6.

Make it yours: Drizzle the remaining cream or whip it to soft peaks (chilling the cream for a couple of hours before using ensures it whips easily and holds its shape) – or serve with a mixture of the two like we have. You can even add ice cream if you have some on hand – you're celebrating, after all!
